==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]] 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while in a [[Stance]])

:[[Energy regeneration]] -1

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Elonian Daggers (rare)]], [[dye]]d black.
